_template_info: TEMPLATE: this folder is never built into the game (folders starting with _ are skipped). To make a character, run:  python3 games/dissidia/tools/charmod.py new <folder> --like <retail code> --display "Name" --series "FINAL FANTASY ..."  It copies this file, fills in the character, gives it a free roster slot and unpacks the based-on character's moves for editing.
_read_me: One extra character. Edit this file and the folders next to it, then start the game (tools/run.sh builds every character
folder in) or build by hand:  python3 games/dissidia/tools/charmod.py build <this folder's name>
character: who it is. name = what menus call it; slot = its roster slot; based_on = the retail character it is built on
(its skeleton, animations, moves and models are the starting point; anything not replaced here stays theirs).
avatars: the menu / HUD pictures. null = the based-on character's picture. Add PNGs in avatars/, or make them all from
one big picture:  charmod.py avatars <folder> --from-picture my_art.png   (charmod.py avatars <folder> = preview)
body: "as_is" = the based-on character's model; give it another body with  charmod.py body <folder> --from-gmo model.gmo --as mine
move_names: in-game name and help text per ability (the key is the ability's number; cmd = its command in moveset/p_<code>/moves.json).
Moves, timing and damage: moveset/p_<code>/ (damage: hits.json "power"; list every hit: charmod.py hits <folder>).
runtime_hooks: extra runtime settings (roster.cpp), usually none. menu_ids: filled in by the build.
files: the character's game files. _auto = every file not listed is the based-on character's.

_info.name: shown in menus (name plate, menus); at most 28 characters
_info.full_name: VS screen and the battle-start banner
_info.series: the logo plate text, e.g. FINAL FANTASY VI
_info.code: 1..6 lower case letters/digits, unique (files are named p_<code>_...)
_info.slot: roster slot 35..42; a taken slot is replaced by the next free one when the character is added
_info.based_on: retail character code it starts from (fiv100 Bartz, eht100 Squall, sev100 Cloud, ten110 Yuna, gst130 Lightning ...)
_info.based_on_id: its charId (filled in by charmod.py new)

avatars._info: Filled in by charmod.py new: one entry per menu / HUD picture.

generated_from._info: the picture the menu art is cut from when the character is first added (a grey placeholder until you set yours); crop boxes x0,y0,x1,y1 in picture pixels per avatar

body._info: "as_is" = the based-on character's model files. Another body: charmod.py body <folder> --from-gmo model.gmo --as mine (then "skin": "mine").

move_names._info: Rename moves: key = the ability's number (hex, as in games/dissidia/docs/roster.md for the based-on character), cmd = its command id in moveset/p_<code>/moves.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Other fields: games/dissidia/extra_abilities.json (_doc).

menu_ids._info: entry ids in the shared menu pack; filled in by the build when the character is added; leave as they are

files._info: game path -> folder path (moveset/..., models/..., files/...) or {"like": retail path}. _auto: every file of the based-on character not listed here is used as it is.
